name: @adhd/sox-store-adapter
description: Unified store adapter — Turso Database (primary) and SQLite (backward-compat) behind a single async interface

concerns: portable error helpers (duck-typed, no instanceof driver classes)
invariants: Adapter instances are NOT shared across consumers — each opens its own connection
transaction() always uses raw BEGIN/COMMIT/ROLLBACK — no db.transaction(fn) wrapper
BEGIN CONCURRENT is TursoAdapter-only — SqliteAdapter throws for mode: 'concurrent'
Errors are driver-native — consumers use portable helpers, never instanceof
